consequence.statement: The `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` flag will be ignored when upgrading to Loki 3.0.0; any configuration using this flag will no longer be honored.

original.statement: The CLI flag `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` has been removed from the shipper configuration in Loki 3.0.0.

consequence.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` and its YAML setting. The index path prefix is now set by `path_prefix` under the `index` key in period_config. If the removed setting was configured to a value other than `index/`, all existing period configs that use `tsdb` as the index must have `path_prefix` set to the earlier value.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, remove `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` (or its YAML setting). In every existing period config that uses `tsdb` as the index, set `index.path_prefix` to the value the flag had.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix`. Operators who set it to something other than `index/` must set `path_prefix` in every existing tsdb period config to that earlier value.

decision.reason: [ev-43cc6d389282] says the key-prefix flags are removed and that the index path prefix is now set with `path_prefix` under the `index` key in period_config. [ev-632a3911583a] names the step operators must take: if `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` was set to anything other than `index/`, set `path_prefix` in every existing tsdb period config to that earlier value. [ev-76a46c52508c] says no changes are needed otherwise. Because the guide prescribes a required config step rather than only saying the value stops being honoured, migration-required fits better than setting-ignored. The class is still mandatory work.
